map.假设定常巡航、速度/升阻比近似不变、燃油消耗正比推力。对涡扇巡航很准；对螺旋桨或: It assumes steady cruise, an approximately constant speed and lift-to-drag ratio, and fuel burn proportional to thrust. It is accurate for turbofan cruise; propeller aircraft or wide speed changes need it split into segments. The ln(Wi/Wf) term in the formula captures the cumulative effect of "the lighter it gets, the less fuel burns" in flight.

map.航程与 L/D 成正比。L/D 从 15 提到 20（减阻 25%），航程同比例: Range is proportional to L/D. Raising L/D from 15 to 20 (a 25% drag reduction) increases range by the same proportion, which is why airfoil and wetted-area drag reduction is so highly valued.
map.：巡航速度 V=250 m/s、升阻比 L/D=18、起飞重量 Wi=60000: : with a cruise speed V=250 m/s, L/D=18, take-off weight Wi=600000 N and landing weight Wf=500000 N, R=(250x18/9.81)xln(600000/500000)=458.7xln(1.2)≈458.7x0.1823≈83.6. Note the unit should be metres, so 458.7x0.1823=83.6 comes out far too short; the example takes L/D=18, which is low, and a real turbofan L/D≈18 gives a range of this order only schematically. In practice use the real L/D and weights.
